Reading Comprehension
Read and answer · Leia e responda
Dialog — A Busy Saturday

Mariana: Hey! What's the matter with you? You look sad today.

Pedro: I'm kind of tired. I didn't sleep well because my car broke down last night and I had to walk home.

Mariana: Oh no! How long did it take you to walk home?

Pedro: It took around 40 minutes on foot. There was a bus stop nearby, but I decided to walk because the weather was cool and I felt like taking a walk.

Mariana: Have you ever had problems with that car before?

Pedro: Yes, it always breaks down. It's different from my old car — that one never had problems. I'm going to spend my money on a new one.

Mariana: Why don't we look for one together this weekend? I'm good at finding good deals!

Pedro: That sounds great. As usual, you always have the best ideas!
